name: New Farm Solar
old_description: Since 2014, New Farm Solar has helped homeowners, farms, and businesses throughout Arkansas, Missouri, and Oklahoma take control of their energy future. From consultation through installation and long-term support, we design systems tailored to your property, your goals, and your budget.
about:
New Farm Solar was founded in 2014 in Rogers, Arkansas, by Patrick Villines. A generational farm kid from Boxley Valley, Villines taught himself off-grid installation while homesteading in the early 2000s, then apprenticed with Rocky Grove Sun Company before earning his NABCEP certification and launching the locally owned business.

The company designs and installs custom solar energy systems for residential, commercial, and agricultural customers across Arkansas, Missouri, and Oklahoma. Its services span rooftop and ground-mount solar arrays, battery backup and off-grid power systems, commercial battery energy storage for peak shaving, EV charging infrastructure, generator installation, solar removal and reinstallation for reroofing projects, and panel cleaning. With a core team of six — including an operations manager, technical support specialist, project coordinator, and creative director — New Farm Solar has completed more than 500 installations since inception.

Customers range from homeowners seeking utility bill reduction to farms and businesses pursuing energy resilience and demand-charge savings. Recent projects include whole-home backup systems for rural properties, commercial peak-shaving installations that lower peak-demand charges, and EV charging deployments for both single-family homes and fleet operations. The firm also services existing arrays through its reroof and cleaning programs.

Villines started the company out of a passion for sustainability and a desire to provide honest, pressure-free guidance. New Farm Solar emphasizes tailored system design over one-size-fits-all packages, and it backs its work with long-term support and NABCEP-certified expertise.
